name: @adatechnology/vehicles-catalog-tool
description: Vehicles catalog tool: reads the Frota Leve (DIMS, the paint palettes), the Frota design cards and the Garagem plugin from the team delivery and writes the data of game-vehicles-fleet as plain JSON, plus the game slice for the zombiada repository, with a --check that fails when the generated files are stale. The compare command runs the Garagem artifact, the site v4 page and the SDK side by side.
